description: Illustrative two-class excerpt of the §0.51 artefact-class corpus. The live registry is generated and spans both planes; this fixture is PUBLIC, so it pins the SHAPE using public-plane classes only — no IP-track path appears here (§33). It shows one class whose identity is probed and one whose records are keyed by a composite and therefore carries an explicit unprobed_reason rather than a silent skip.

excluded_dirs.examples: illustrative fixtures validated against schemas — an example of a registry is not a source of truth

excluded_files.dictionary.json: a controlled vocabulary, not an instance registry — governed as the dictionary OF the class it serves

evidence.ledger: the per-gate verdict ledger written by the gate runner at emission
evidence.note: Obligation verdicts derive from that ledger plus the sweep's own probes — no obligation is satisfied by declaration.

classes.unprobed_reason: Identity is not probed: no single property carries the instance identifier for this class — its records are keyed by a composite of fields, so there is no field for a pattern to bind to.
